description: This file defines the interface and classes for a UDP socket implementation specific to the Starboard platform, including socket operations, asynchronous write support, multicast management, and socket configuration.

classes.name: SendResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a UDP send operation, including return value, write count, and buffers.

classes.name: UDPSocketStarboardSender
classes.description: A reference-counted class responsible for sending UDP buffers over a Starboard socket.

classes.name: UDPSocketStarboard
classes.description: A class implementing a UDP socket for the Starboard platform, supporting asynchronous operations, multicast, and socket configuration.

methods.name: SendBuffers
methods.description: Sends multiple datagram buffers over a socket to a specified address.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a UDP socket with the specified address family.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific network handle.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects the socket to a remote address.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote address the socket is connected to.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: ReadMultiplePackets
methods.description: Reads multiple packets from the socket.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes data buffers to the socket.

methods.name: GetUnwrittenBuffers
methods.description: Returns buffers that have not yet been written.

methods.name: RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives data from the socket along with sender address.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specific address.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Sets the socket to not fragment packets.

methods.name: SetMsgConfirm
methods.description: Enables or disables MSG_CONFIRM flag.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected or bound.

methods.name: AllowAddressReuse
methods.description: Enables address reuse option.

methods.name: SetBroadcast
methods.description: Enables or disables broadcast packets.

methods.name: AllowAddressSharingForMulticast
methods.description: Enables sharing of local address for multicast.

methods.name: JoinGroup
methods.description: Joins a multicast group.

methods.name: LeaveGroup
methods.description: Leaves a multicast group.

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets the interface for multicast.

methods.name: SetMulticastTimeToLive
methods.description: Sets the TTL for multicast packets.

methods.name: SetMulticastLoopbackMode
methods.description: Enables or disables multicast loopback.

methods.name: SetDiffServCodePoint
methods.description: Sets DSCP flags on outgoing packets.

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Resets thread affinity for thread-safety.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag.

methods.name: SetWriteAsyncEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables asynchronous write.

methods.name: SetMaxPacketSize
methods.description: Sets maximum packet size.

methods.name: SetWriteMultiCoreEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables multi-core write optimization.

methods.name: SetWriteBatchingActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates write batching.

methods.name: SetWriteAsyncMaxBuffers
methods.description: Sets maximum buffers for async write.

methods.name: enable_experimental_recv_optimization
methods.description: Enables experimental receive optimization.

methods.name: AdoptOpenedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing socket descriptor.
